# `aitbc system restart`

Restart a systemd service by name.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system restart [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service` | text | — | yes | Service to restart (e.g., blockchain-node, wallet) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system restart --service <service>
```
